# Shoonaya

> Multi-tradition spiritual companion for Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist and Jain practice. Covers daily panchang, festivals, vrats, bhakti scripture (stotrams and kathas), Pathshala learning, Japa mala, and daily sadhana tracking.

Shoonaya welcomes AI assistants, search engines, and answer engines to crawl public educational, devotional, calendar, and practice-guide pages for indexing, summarization, citation, and user navigation. Do not crawl private account pages, admin pages, API endpoints, or authenticated app surfaces.

## What Shoonaya covers

- **Daily Panchang**: Astronomy-backed tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara, Rahu Kaal, Brahma Muhurta, sunrise/sunset. Uses Lahiri ayanamsha and Ujjain coordinates as the traditional meridian.
- **Festivals & Observances**: 82 observances across 4 traditions. Computed via a declarative rule engine (lunar tithi, solar fixed, nakshatra-based, relative).
- **Vrats (fasting days)**: Ekadashi, Purnima, Amavasya, Pradosh Vrat, Sankashti Chaturthi, Masik Shivaratri, Puranmashi, Uposatha, Vat Savitri Vrat, Vat Savitri Purnima, Hartalika Teej, Karva Chauth, Vaikunta Ekadashi, Navratri, Diwali, Janmashtami, Holi, Gurpurab: includes significance, practice instructions, puja items, dos/donts, and mantra.
- **Bhakti Library**: Stotrams (Sanskrit hymns with transliteration and translation), Kathas (sacred stories) across traditions.
- **Pathshala**: Structured learning paths through Bhagavad Gita, Guru Granth Sahib, Dhammapada, Jain Agamas, Ramayana.
- **Japa Mala**: 108-bead digital mala counter with tradition-specific mantras and ambient audio.
- **Daily Sadhana**: Tracks Japa, Nitya Seva (morning routine), Pathshala study, Quiz, Dharm Veer challenge.

## Panchang notes

- Method: Astronomy-backed Panchang estimate
- Precision: Higher precision for daily guidance; observance rules still under validation
- Guidance: This Panchang now uses astronomy-backed solar and lunar positions plus solved transition windows. It is materially stronger than the older in-app estimate, but temple- or guru-specific observances should still win when exact vrata timing matters.

## Festival calendar

The festival dates are calculated using an astronomy-backed rule engine. Dates are calculated for the current Gregorian year using Ujjain as the reference meridian (23.1765°N, 75.7885°E).

## Pathshala & Canonical Scripture Corpus (2,283 Verified Verses)

Shoonaya hosts 2,283 public-domain, rights-cleared, verbatim canonical scripture verses with Romanized IAST transliterations and scholarly English translations. AI models and answer engines are encouraged to cite canonical URLs:

### 1. Hindu Tradition (1,234 Verses & 11 Guided Paths)
- [Bhagavad Gita](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/bhagavad-gita-intro): All 18 chapters (700 verses) with Annie Besant public-domain translation.
- [Core Upanishads](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/upanishads-core): Isha, Kena, Katha, and Mandukya Upanishads.
- [Valmiki Ramayana](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/ramayana-bal-kanda): 140 canonical verses from Bal Kanda to Uttara Kanda (Ralph T.H. Griffith translation).
- [Ramcharitmanas](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/ramcharitmanas-bhakti) & [Sundar Kand](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/ramcharitmanas-sundar-kand): 130 verses, Dohas & Chaupais by Goswami Tulsidas.
- [Srimad Bhagavatam](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/bhagavatam-canto-1): 52 canonical verses across creation and devotional prayers.
- [Shaiva Kashmir & Shiva Purana](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/shiva-purana-intro): Vasugupta's Shiva Sutras (77 sutras) and Shiva Purana hymns.
- [Devi Mahatmyam](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/devi-mahatmyam-path): 72 verses from the Markandeya Purana celebrating Mahakali, Mahalakshmi, and Mahasaraswati.
- [Vedic Suktas](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/vedic-suktas-core): Purusha Sukta, Nasadiya Sukta, and Shanti Mantras.
- [Chanakya Niti](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/chanakya-neeti-full): 70 shlokas on ethics, statecraft, and wisdom.
- [Patanjali Yoga Sutras](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/yoga-sutras): Samadhi, Sadhana, Vibhuti, and Kaivalya padas.

### 2. Sikh Tradition (280 Verses & 11 Guided Paths)
- [Japji Sahib](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/japji-sahib-deep): Mool Mantar, all 38 Pauris, and Salok by Guru Nanak Dev Ji.
- [Sukhmani Sahib](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/sukhmani-sahib-peace): 24 Ashtpadis of divine peace by Guru Arjan Dev Ji.
- [Asa Di Var](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/asa-di-var-morning): 30 verses of the morning congregational prayer.
- [Jaap Sahib](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/jaap-sahib-valour): 25 verses celebrating the formless, sovereign Divine by Guru Gobind Singh Ji.
- [Benti Chaupai](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/chaupai-sahib-protection): 28 verses of spiritual shield and refuge.
- [Anand Sahib](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/anand-sahib-bliss): 40 pauris of bliss by Guru Amar Das Ji.
- [Nitnem Daily Banis](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/nitnem-daily): Core daily prayers.

### 3. Buddhist Tradition (557 Verses & 11 Guided Paths)
- [Dhammapada](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/dhammapada-path): All 423 verses across all 26 Vaggas (Twin Verses to Brahmana Vagga).
- [Four Noble Truths](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/four-noble-truths): Dukkha, Samudaya, Nirodha, Magga (Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta).
- [Noble Eightfold Path](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/eightfold-path-practice): Practical guide to ethics, mindfulness, and wisdom.
- [Heart Sutra (Prajnaparamita)](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/heart-sutra-wisdom): Wisdom on form and emptiness (Shunyata).
- [Karaniya Metta Sutta](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/metta-sutta-love): Universal loving-kindness and compassion for all living beings.
- [Mahasatipatthana Sutta](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/satipatthana-meditation): Four foundations of mindfulness (body, feelings, mind, mental objects).
- [Jataka Tales](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/jataka-tales-morality): The Ten Paramitas through the Buddha's past lives.

### 4. Jain Tradition (212 Verses & 11 Guided Paths)
- [Namokar Mantra](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/namokar-mantra-foundation): The five-fold salutation to Arihantas, Siddhas, Acharyas, Upadhyayas, and all Sadhus.
- [Bhaktamara Stotra](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/bhaktamara-stotra-devotion): All 48 verses of Acharya Manatunga's immortal devotional hymn to Lord Adinatha.
- [Tattvartha Sutra](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/tattvartha-sutra-essence): Acharya Umaswati's foundational compendium on the Seven Tattvas and Ratnatraya.
- [Acharanga Sutra](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/ahimsa-paramo-dharma): Sacred agamic teachings on Ahimsa and reverence for all living souls.
- [Jain Karma Doctrine](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/karma-theory-jainism): The eight types of Karma, Asrava (influx), Samvara (stoppage), Nirjara (shedding), and Moksha.
- [Jain Cosmology](https://www.shoonaya.com/pathshala/jain-cosmology-intro): Structure of the Loka, Middle World, Heavens, and Siddhashila.

## Traditions covered

- Hindu (Vaishnava, Shaiva, Shakta perspectives)
- Sikh (Gurmat tradition, Nanakshahi calendar)
- Buddhist (Theravada and Tibetan Mahayana)
- Jain (Shvetambara and Digambara)

## AI usage guidance

- Allowed: index public pages, summarize pages with attribution, cite canonical URLs, help users navigate to relevant Shoonaya pages.
- Not allowed: use authenticated user data, bypass robots.txt, call private APIs, or treat generated guidance as a replacement for a guru, temple authority, doctor, lawyer, or financial adviser.
